nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Environment variable template for the Waggle landing page (apps/www), documenting the required Stripe publishable/secret keys and the legacy VITE_API_URL pointing to cloud.waggle-os.ai; placeholder values intentionally trigger a configuration-required guard to prevent accidental real Stripe calls.

nodes.name: .env.local.example
nodes.summary: Full environment variable template for the Waggle www Next.js landing app covering Clerk auth (publishable key, secret key, webhook secret, redirect URLs), Stripe billing (secret key, webhook secret, and four price IDs for PRO/TEAMS monthly/annual tiers); intended to be copied to .env.local and filled with real values.
nodes.languageNotes: Distinguishes NEXT_PUBLIC_* (client-safe) from server-only variables; all four Stripe price IDs are resolved by lookup_key at runtime with env vars as explicit pinning fallback.

nodes.name: LIGHTHOUSE.md
nodes.summary: Lighthouse audit report for the Waggle www landing page covering Sesija D §3.3 final pass, documenting performance/accessibility/best-practice scores (acceptance threshold ≥85/≥95/≥95), Core Web Vitals, two critical fixes applied, and reproducibility methodology.

nodes.name: SESIJA-D-MANIFEST.md
nodes.summary: Session D manifest for the apps/www Next.js port v3.2, recording 12 commits, 16-item acceptance criteria from amendment §3, out-of-scope items, day-2 polish backlog, verification artifacts, and the repo state at session end.

nodes.name: SESIJA-E-MANIFEST.md
nodes.summary: Session E manifest for the apps/www landing, covering Clerk auth integration, Stripe-Clerk customer linkage, branding fixes, local webhook listener setup, end-to-end smoke test procedures, troubleshooting guide, and §5.3 acceptance criteria.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the waggle-www Next.js 15 landing app, declaring dependencies on Clerk auth (@clerk/nextjs, @clerk/themes), Stripe, React 19, next-intl for i18n, and react-markdown, with standard next dev/build/start/lint scripts and vitest for unit tests.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the apps/www Next.js landing, enabling strict mode with ES2022 target, bundler module resolution, Next.js plugin integration, and a single path alias @/* mapping to the project root.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses moduleResolution: bundler (Next.js 15 default) and noEmit: true since Next.js handles emit via its own build pipeline; incremental mode enabled for faster type-check iterations.
